title: Delivery plan - Norn Project Web 2.1.0
target: Ship the complete local Web project-tracking experience in arka-norn 2.1.0, with Tauri explicitly deferred to phase 2.
nature: Cross-cutting product Feature spanning domain contracts, application projections, filesystem adapters, a secured loopback inbound adapter, a React renderer, packaging and documentation.
completion_criteria: Every registered Project, Feature, Pipeline stage, supported document, audit, Agent and Norn orchestration is represented from real repository data.
All framework documents are readable through one schema-driven human renderer with provenance, dependencies and raw technical disclosure.
Human decisions are append-only, attributable, portable and never mutate signed framework documents.
The Web API is loopback-only, authenticated, origin checked, path constrained and free of prompts, secrets, stderr and raw terminal output.
Orchestration observation survives navigation and reconnects from durable registries without exposing mutation controls or invented progress.
The complete interface works in English and French, is keyboard accessible at 1024, 1440 and 1920 pixels, and ships inside the npm tarball.
Build, lint, max-lines, language, unit, integration, E2E, coverage, selftest, dependency audit and packaging gates pass.
guiding_principle: All UI state is a human projection of durable Norn contracts; mutations are explicit governance actions, never hidden browser state.

locked: Local Web delivery is complete in 2.1.0; Tauri remains a separate phase 2 Feature behind NornBridge.
Agents are visible contributors and orchestration subjects, never controllable resources in the Web UI.
Documents remain immutable and execution registries remain the live source of truth.
No maintained code or generated contract is copied from the private mock or Cortex Deck.
objective_to_prove: A generic presentation model can render every canonical and supported legacy schema without losing critical meaning.
Filesystem invalidation plus full snapshot reload remains reliable across supported operating systems and detached workers.
The secured local server and future Tauri bridge can share one frontend contract without runtime coupling.

batches.name: Canonical contracts and reusable projections
batches.description: Add human profile and governance contracts, move shared Project/Feature projections out of TUI ownership, and define document, graph, audit, Agent and orchestration read models.

batches.name: Secure loopback application service
batches.description: Implement NornBridge application methods, the authenticated API v1, static asset serving, route allowlists and the arka-norn web command.

batches.name: Project manager Web experience
batches.description: Create the tracked React/Vite application, design system, stable resource routing and EN/FR Project, Feature, workflow, document, decision, audit, Agent, activity and settings views.

batches.name: Human governance and operational actions
batches.description: Wire profile onboarding, append-only decisions, Project/Feature creation, audit lifecycle and confirmed Doctor repairs without exposing Agent orchestration mutations.

batches.name: Live observation and relationship graph
batches.description: Watch durable registries and heartbeats, stream authenticated invalidations, reconnect safely, and render deterministic scoped relationships and orchestration timelines.

batches.name: Distribution, documentation and release gates
batches.description: Integrate filtered catalog generation and Web build into the npm package, update public English documentation and version metadata, then run functional, security, accessibility and packaging verification.
